notes.title: The first official trailer has been released!
notes.content:
x-climb Co., Ltd. (Headquarters: Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo; CEO: Atsushi Iiburi) is thrilled to unveil the first official trailer for STEAM TRIGGER, an upcoming steampunk-inspired Metroidvania 2.5D action-adventure game.

Official Trailer: [previewyoutube=DC2Mcv5Afxo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]About STEAM TRIGGER
[/b]Set against the backdrop of a vast steampunk metropolis, STEAM TRIGGER fuses industrial progress with Victorian aesthetics in an enthralling 2.5D Metroidvania experience. Venture into a richly detailed world, where every alley, rooftop, and hidden passage beckons exploration.

Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698100/STEAM_TRIGGER/

[b]Release Information
[/b]
[list]
[*] Planned Release: 2025
[*] Platforms: PC / Various Consoles
[*] Supported Languages: Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Korean, Russian, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese
[*] Genre: Metroidvania
[*] Official Social Media
[*] X (formerly Twitter): https://x.com/xclimb_games
[*] YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@xclimb7017
[/list]

[b]Key Features
[/b]
Steampunk Aesthetics
Encounter a variety of enemies—from humanoids to fearsome wolves—all sporting intricately crafted steampunk designs. These unique styles add depth and allure to every battle.

Combat & Agility
Play as the female protagonist, Eva, wielding a graceful sword. Combine slashes, quick jumps, and slides for a stylish, fast-paced combat experience.

Boss Battles
Test your mettle against powerful bosses, each requiring a distinct strategy. These encounters push your skills to the limit, offering immensely satisfying victories.

Exploration & Discovery
Delve into each level to uncover hidden paths and secrets that enrich your playthrough. Exploration is key to mastering the game and unlocking its full potential.

Stunning Visuals
Every stage is meticulously crafted to deliver a visually captivating experience that complements the gameplay. The art style bridges tradition and modernity, immersing players in a fully realized steampunk world.
